D.t: Patty Garcia leads by 52.7 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 139,399 votes; a one point swing is about 1,323 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +46.0 and D +58.6. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.

D.h: What the ballots so far say
D.t: The early vote has moved this forecast 0.3 points toward Patty Garcia. Bank it: chase the remaining mail ballots and low propensity voters who have not voted.

R.t: Lupe Castillo trails by 52.7 and wins 0% of simulations. Closing it takes about 69,700 voters switching sides, or 139,399 more net votes from new turnout.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +58.6 and D +46.0. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
